rules.description: Meaningless repeated messages flooding the channel.
Content likely to make other users uncomfortable or offended.

Sexual, explicit or NSFW content, or vulgar language used to degrade someone. Casual expressive profanity aimed at no one is NOT a violation — 'ㅋㅋㅋ 개웃기네 시발' or '아 씨발 죽었네' is ordinary game chat. Swearing aimed AT a person belongs to `directed_profanity` instead.
Any discriminatory remarks based on race, gender, disability, region of origin, etc.

title.jp: 不適切なニックネーム・プロフィール

rules.description: Using an inappropriate nickname or profile picture. (Note: usually not detectable from message text alone.)
Advertising posts, promotion, or content that induces gambling / speculation.
Leaking another person's personal information (name, address, phone number, IP, etc.).

title.jp: 他ゲーム・他コミュニティの宣伝

rules.description: Content or promotion related to games or communities other than Elancia.

title.jp: 運営・スタッフのなりすまし

rules.description: Impersonating the developers, team members, outsourced staff, or any equivalent.
Sharing or spreading game exploits or vulnerabilities.

Disparaging, mocking, belittling or attacking a specific person. The target does NOT need to be named: it counts if the target is identifiable from a reply, a mention, a quote, the immediately preceding exchange, a repeated referent ('that guy', 'still at it'), or a reference to their profile. Negative verdicts about a person's character, intelligence, mindset or humanity count even when phrased as opinion.

Using mental illness or psychiatric conditions as an insult toward a person (e.g. Korean '정병', '정신병자', '환각증세'). Distinct from `discrimination`, which covers attacks on a group. Genuine discussion of mental health is NOT a violation.
Describing a person as sub-human — vermin, an animal, garbage, or something to be discarded (e.g. Korean '벌레', '인간 고쳐 쓰는 게 아니다'). Applies even without profanity.

Publicly mocking or expressing disgust at a person's face, body, voice, or profile picture, or demanding they hide it (e.g. Korean '얼굴 좀 가려주세요'). Distinct from `inappropriate_profile`, which is about the profile itself being unsuitable.

Swearing aimed AT a specific person, as opposed to an exclamation about a situation (e.g. Korean '왜 지랄이세요?' directed at someone). Non-targeted venting like '아 씨발 죽었네' is NOT this rule. When this applies, `targeted_harassment` usually applies as well.
